versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֗י אַֽחֲרֵי֙ מ֣וֹת שָׁא֔וּל וְדָוִ֣ד שָׁ֔ב מֵהַכּ֖וֹת אֶת־הָעֲמָלֵ֑ק וַיֵּ֧שֶׁב דָּוִ֛ד בְּצִקְלָ֖ג יָמִ֥ים שְׁנָֽיִם׃

controles.web: After the death of Saul, when David had returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had stayed two days in Ziklag;
controles.kjv: Now it came to pass after the death of Saul, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had abode two days in Ziklag;
controles.livre: E aconteceu depois da morte de Saul, que quando Davi voltou da derrota dos amalequitas, ficou dois dias em Ziclague;

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֣י׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֗י וְהִנֵּה֩ אִ֨ישׁ בָּ֤א מִן־הַֽמַּחֲנֶה֙ מֵעִ֣ם שָׁא֔וּל וּבְגָדָ֣יו קְרֻעִ֔ים וַאֲדָמָ֖ה עַל־רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַיְהִי֙ בְּבֹא֣וֹ אֶל־דָּוִ֔ד וַיִּפֹּ֥ל אַ֖רְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּֽחוּ׃

controles.web: on the third day, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul, with his clothes torn, and earth on his head: and so it was, when he came to David, that he fell to the earth, and showed respect.
controles.kjv: It came even to pass on the third day, that, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul with his clothes rent, and earth upon his head: and so it was, when he came to David, that he fell to the earth, and did obeisance.
controles.livre: E ao terceiro dia aconteceu, que veio um do acampamento de Saul, rasgadas suas roupas, e terra sobre sua cabeça: e chegando a Davi, prostrou-se em terra, e fez reverência.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ דָּוִ֔ד אֵ֥י מִזֶּ֖ה תָּב֑וֹא וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו מִמַּחֲנֵ֥ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נִמְלָֽטְתִּי׃

controles.web: David said to him, “Where do you come from?”   He said to him, “I have escaped out of the camp of Israel.”
controles.kjv: And David said unto him, From whence comest thou? And he said unto him, Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped.
controles.livre: E perguntou-lhe Davi: De onde vens? E ele respondeu: Eu me escapei do acampamento de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֥יו דָּוִ֛ד מֶה־הָיָ֥ה הַדָּבָ֖ר הַגֶּד־נָ֣א לִ֑י וַ֠יֹּאמֶר אֲשֶׁר־נָ֨ס הָעָ֜ם מִן־הַמִּלְחָמָ֗ה וְגַם־הַרְבֵּ֞ה נָפַ֤ל מִן־הָעָם֙ וַיָּמֻ֔תוּ וְגַ֗ם שָׁא֛וּל וִיהוֹנָתָ֥ן בְּנ֖וֹ מֵֽתוּ׃

controles.web: David said to him, “How did it go? Please tell me.”   He answered, “The people have fled from the battle, and many of the people also have fallen and are dead; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.”
controles.kjv: And David said unto him, How went the matter? I pray thee, tell me. And he answered, That the people are fled from the battle, and many of the people also are fallen and dead; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.
controles.livre: E Davi lhe disse: Que aconteceu? Rogo-te que me digas. E ele respondeu: O povo fugiu da batalha, e também muitos do povo caíram e foram mortos: também Saul e Jônatas seu filho morreram.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔ד אֶל־הַנַּ֖עַר הַמַּגִּ֣יד ל֑וֹ אֵ֣יךְ יָדַ֔עְתָּ כִּי־מֵ֥ת שָׁא֖וּל וִיהֽוֹנָתָ֥ן בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: David said to the young man who told him, “How do you know that Saul and Jonathan his son are dead?”
controles.kjv: And David said unto the young man that told him, How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead?
controles.livre: E disse Davi àquele rapaz que lhe dava as novas: Como sabes que Saul está morto, e Jônatas seu filho?

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֜אמֶר הַנַּ֣עַר׀ הַמַּגִּ֣יד ל֗וֹ נִקְרֹ֤א נִקְרֵ֨יתִי֙ בְּהַ֣ר הַגִּלְבֹּ֔עַ וְהִנֵּ֥ה שָׁא֖וּל נִשְׁעָ֣ן עַל־חֲנִית֑וֹ וְהִנֵּ֥ה הָרֶ֛כֶב וּבַעֲלֵ֥י הַפָּרָשִׁ֖ים הִדְבִּקֻֽהוּ׃

controles.web: The young man who told him said, “As I happened by chance on Mount Gilboa, behold, Saul was leaning on his spear; and behold, the chariots and the horsemen followed hard after him.
controles.kjv: And the young man that told him said, As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa, behold, Saul leaned upon his spear; and, lo, the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him.
controles.livre: E o rapaz que lhe dava as novas respondeu: Casualmente vim ao monte de Gilboa, e achei a Saul que estava recostado sobre sua lança, e vinham atrás dele carros e cavaleiros.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּ֥פֶן אַחֲרָ֖יו וַיִּרְאֵ֑נִי וַיִּקְרָ֣א אֵלָ֔י וָאֹמַ֖ר הִנֵּֽנִי׃

controles.web: When he looked behind him, he saw me, and called to me. I answered, ‘Here I am.’
controles.kjv: And when he looked behind him, he saw me, and called unto me. And I answered, Here am I.
controles.livre: E quando ele olhou atrás, viu-me e chamou-me; e eu disse: Eis-me aqui.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לִ֖י מִי־אָ֑תָּה ויאמר אֵלָ֔יו עֲמָלֵקִ֖י אָנֹֽכִי׃

controles.web: He said to me, ‘Who are you?’ I answered him, ‘I am an Amalekite.’
controles.kjv: And he said unto me, Who art thou? And I answered him, I am an Amalekite.
controles.livre: E ele me disse: Quem és tu? E eu lhe respondi: Sou amalequita.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י עֲמָד־נָ֤א עָלַי֙ וּמֹ֣תְתֵ֔נִי כִּ֥י אֲחָזַ֖נִי הַשָּׁבָ֑ץ כִּֽי־כָל־ע֥וֹד נַפְשִׁ֖י בִּֽי׃

controles.web: He said to me, ‘Please stand beside me, and kill me; for anguish has taken hold of me, because my life is yet whole in me.’
controles.kjv: He said unto me again, Stand, I pray thee, upon me, and slay me: for anguish is come upon me, because my life is yet whole in me.
controles.livre: E ele me voltou a dizer: Eu te rogo que te ponhas sobre mim, e me mates, porque me tomam angústias, e toda minha alma está ainda em mim.

versos.hebraico: וָאֶעֱמֹ֤ד עָלָיו֙ וַאֲמֹ֣תְתֵ֔הוּ כִּ֣י יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֛י לֹ֥א יִֽחְיֶ֖ה אַחֲרֵ֣י נִפְל֑וֹ וָאֶקַּ֞ח הַנֵּ֣זֶר׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־רֹאשׁ֗וֹ וְאֶצְעָדָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־זְרֹע֔וֹ וָאֲבִיאֵ֥ם אֶל־אֲדֹנִ֖י הֵֽנָּה׃

controles.web: So I stood beside him, and killed him, because I was sure that he could not live after that he had fallen. I took the crown that was on his head, and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them here to my lord.”
controles.kjv: So I stood upon him, and slew him, because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen: and I took the crown that was upon his head, and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them hither unto my lord.
controles.livre: Eu então me pus sobre ele, e matei-o, porque sabia que não podia viver depois de sua queda: e tomei a coroa que tinha em sua cabeça, e o bracelete que trazia em seu braço, e trouxe-os aqui a meu senhor.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּחֲזֵ֥ק דָּוִ֛ד בבגדו וַיִּקְרָעֵ֑ם וְגַ֥ם כָּל־הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Then David took hold on his clothes, and tore them; and likewise all the men who were with him.
controles.kjv: Then David took hold on his clothes, and rent them; and likewise all the men that were with him:
controles.livre: Então Davi agarrando suas roupas, rompeu-os; e o mesmo fizeram os homens que estavam com ele.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיִּסְפְּדוּ֙ וַיִּבְכּ֔וּ וַיָּצֻ֖מוּ עַד־הָעָ֑רֶב עַל־שָׁא֞וּל וְעַל־יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן בְּנ֗וֹ וְעַל־עַ֤ם יְהוָה֙ וְעַל־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֥י נָפְל֖וּ בֶּחָֽרֶב׃ס

controles.web: They mourned, and wept, and fasted until evening, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of Yahweh, and for the house of Israel; because they were fallen by the sword.
controles.kjv: And they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of the Lord, and for the house of Israel; because they were fallen by the sword.
controles.livre: E choraram e lamentaram, e jejuaram até à tarde, por Saul e por Jônatas seu filho, e pelo povo do SENHOR, e pela casa de Israel: porque haviam caído à espada.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֗ד אֶל־הַנַּ֨עַר֙ הַמַּגִּ֣יד ל֔וֹ אֵ֥י מִזֶּ֖ה אָ֑תָּה וַיֹּ֕אמֶר בֶּן־אִ֛ישׁ גֵּ֥ר עֲמָלֵקִ֖י אָנֹֽכִי׃

controles.web: David said to the young man who told him, “Where are you from?”   He answered, “I am the son of a foreigner, an Amalekite.”
controles.kjv: And David said unto the young man that told him, Whence art thou? And he answered, I am the son of a stranger, an Amalekite.
controles.livre: E Davi disse a aquele rapaz que lhe havia trazido as novas: De onde és tu? E ele respondeu: Eu sou filho de um estrangeiro, amalequita.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖יו דָּוִ֑ד אֵ֚יךְ לֹ֣א יָרֵ֔אתָ לִשְׁלֹ֨חַ֙ יָֽדְךָ֔ לְשַׁחֵ֖ת אֶת־מְשִׁ֥יחַ יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: David said to him, “How were you not afraid to stretch out your hand to destroy Yahweh’s anointed?”
controles.kjv: And David said unto him, How wast thou not afraid to stretch forth thine hand to destroy the Lord’s anointed?
controles.livre: E disse-lhe Davi: Como não tiveste temor de estender tua mão para matar ao ungido do SENHOR?

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְרָ֣א דָוִ֗ד לְאַחַד֙ מֵֽהַנְּעָרִ֔ים וַיֹּ֖אמֶר גַּ֣שׁ פְּגַע־בּ֑וֹ וַיַּכֵּ֖הוּ וַיָּמֹֽת׃

controles.web: David called one of the young men, and said, “Go near, and fall on him.” He struck him, so that he died.
controles.kjv: And David called one of the young men, and said, Go near, and fall upon him. And he smote him that he died.
controles.livre: Então chamou Davi um dos rapazes, e disse-lhe: Chega, e mata-o. E ele o feriu, e morreu.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ דָּוִ֔ד דמיך עַל־רֹאשֶׁ֑ךָ כִּ֣י פִ֗יךָ עָנָ֤ה בְךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אָנֹכִ֥י מֹתַ֖תִּי אֶת־מְשִׁ֥יחַ יְהוָֽה׃ס

controles.web: David said to him, “Your blood be on your head; for your mouth has testified against you, saying, ‘I have slain Yahweh’s anointed.’”
controles.kjv: And David said unto him, Thy blood be upon thy head; for thy mouth hath testified against thee, saying, I have slain the Lord’s anointed.
controles.livre: E Davi lhe disse: Teu sangue seja sobre tua cabeça, pois que tua boca testemunhou contra ti, dizendo: Eu matei ao ungido do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיְקֹנֵ֣ן דָּוִ֔ד אֶת־הַקִּינָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את עַל־שָׁא֖וּל וְעַל־יְהוֹנָתָ֥ן בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son
controles.kjv: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son:
controles.livre: E lamentou Davi a Saul e a Jônatas seu filho com esta lamentação.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לְלַמֵּ֥ד בְּנֵֽי־יְהוּדָ֖ה קָ֑שֶׁת הִנֵּ֥ה כְתוּבָ֖ה עַל־סֵ֥פֶר הַיָּשָֽׁר׃

controles.web: (and he commanded them to teach the children of Judah the song of the bow: behold, it is written in the book of Jashar):
controles.kjv: (Also he bade them teach the children of Judah the use of the bow: behold, it is written in the book of Jasher.)
controles.livre: (Disse também que ensinassem ao arco aos filhos de Judá. Eis que está escrito no livro do direito:)

versos.hebraico: הַצְּבִי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַל־בָּמוֹתֶ֖יךָ חָלָ֑ל אֵ֖יךְ נָפְל֥וּ גִבּוֹרִֽים׃

controles.web: “Your glory, Israel, is slain on your high places! How the mighty have fallen!
controles.kjv: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places: how are the mighty fallen!
controles.livre: Pereceu a glória de Israel sobre tuas montanhas! Como caíram os valentes!

versos.hebraico: אַל־תַּגִּ֣ידוּ בְגַ֔ת אַֽל־תְּבַשְּׂר֖וּ בְּחוּצֹ֣ת אַשְׁקְל֑וֹן פֶּן־תִּשְׂמַ֨חְנָה֙ בְּנ֣וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים פֶּֽן־תַּעֲלֹ֖זְנָה בְּנ֥וֹת הָעֲרֵלִֽים׃

controles.web: Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t publish it in the streets of Ashkelon, lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.
controles.kjv: Tell it not in Gath, publish it not in the streets of Askelon; lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.
controles.livre: Não o anuncieis em Gate, Não deis as novas nas praças de Asquelom; Para que não se alegrem as filhas dos filisteus, Para que não saltem de alegria as filhas dos incircuncisos.

versos.hebraico: הָרֵ֣י בַגִּלְבֹּ֗עַ אַל־טַ֧ל וְאַל־מָטָ֛ר עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם וּשְׂדֵ֣י תְרוּמֹ֑ת כִּ֣י שָׁ֤ם נִגְעַל֙ מָגֵ֣ן גִּבּוֹרִ֔ים מָגֵ֣ן שָׁא֔וּל בְּלִ֖י מָשִׁ֥יחַ בַּשָּֽׁמֶן׃

controles.web: You mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew nor rain on you, neither fields of offerings; For there the shield of the mighty was vilely cast away, The shield of Saul was not anointed with oil.
controles.kjv: Ye mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew, neither let there be rain, upon you, nor fields of offerings: for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away, the shield of Saul, as though he had not been anointed with oil.
controles.livre: Montes de Gilboa, nem orvalho nem chuva caia sobre vós, nem sejais terras de ofertas; Porque ali foi rejeitado o escudo dos valentes, O escudo de Saul, como se não houvesse sido ungido com azeite.

versos.hebraico: מִדַּ֣ם חֲלָלִ֗ים מֵחֵ֨לֶב֙ גִּבּוֹרִ֔ים קֶ֚שֶׁת יְה֣וֹנָתָ֔ן לֹ֥א נָשׂ֖וֹג אָח֑וֹר וְחֶ֣רֶב שָׁא֔וּל לֹ֥א תָשׁ֖וּב רֵיקָֽם׃

controles.web: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, Jonathan’s bow didn’t turn back. Saul’s sword didn’t return empty.
controles.kjv: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan turned not back, and the sword of Saul returned not empty.
controles.livre: Do sangue de mortos, da gordura de valentes, o arco de Jônatas nunca retrocedeu, nem a espada de Saul voltou vazia.

versos.hebraico: שָׁא֣וּל וִיהוֹנָתָ֗ן הַנֶּאֱהָבִ֤ים וְהַנְּעִימִם֙ בְּחַיֵּיהֶ֔ם וּבְמוֹתָ֖ם לֹ֣א נִפְרָ֑דוּ מִנְּשָׁרִ֣ים קַ֔לּוּ מֵאֲרָי֖וֹת גָּבֵֽרוּ׃

controles.web: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives. In their death, they were not divided. They were swifter than eagles. They were stronger than lions.
controles.kjv: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives, and in their death they were not divided: they were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.
controles.livre: Saul e Jônatas, amados e queridos em sua vida, Em sua morte tampouco foram separados: Mais ligeiros que águas, Mais fortes que leões.

versos.hebraico: בְּנוֹת֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל־שָׁא֖וּל בְּכֶ֑ינָה הַמַּלְבִּֽשְׁכֶ֤ם שָׁנִי֙ עִם־עֲדָנִ֔ים הַֽמַּעֲלֶה֙ עֲדִ֣י זָהָ֔ב עַ֖ל לְבוּשְׁכֶֽן׃

controles.web: You daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you in scarlet delicately, who put ornaments of gold on your clothing.
controles.kjv: Ye daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you in scarlet, with other delights, who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel.
controles.livre: Filhas de Israel, chorai sobre Saul, Que vos vestia de escarlata em regozijo, Que adornava vossas roupas com ornamentos de ouro.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֚יךְ נָפְל֣וּ גִבֹּרִ֔ים בְּת֖וֹךְ הַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה יְה֣וֹנָתָ֔ן עַל־בָּמוֹתֶ֖יךָ חָלָֽל׃

controles.web: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! Jonathan is slain on your high places.
controles.kjv: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! O Jonathan, thou wast slain in thine high places.
controles.livre: Como caíram os valentes em meio da batalha! Jônatas, morto em tuas alturas!

versos.hebraico: צַר־לִ֣י עָלֶ֗יךָ אָחִי֙ יְה֣וֹנָתָ֔ן נָעַ֥מְתָּ לִּ֖י מְאֹ֑ד נִפְלְאַ֤תָה אַהֲבָֽתְךָ֙ לִ֔י מֵאַהֲבַ֖ת נָשִֽׁים׃

controles.web: I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan. You have been very pleasant to me. Your love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.
controles.kjv: I am distressed for thee, my brother Jonathan: very pleasant hast thou been unto me: thy love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.
controles.livre: Angústia tenho por ti, irmão meu Jônatas, Que me foste muito doce: Mais maravilhoso me foi o teu amor, Que o amor das mulheres.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֚יךְ נָפְל֣וּ גִבּוֹרִ֔ים וַיֹּאבְד֖וּ כְּלֵ֥י מִלְחָמָֽה׃פ

controles.web: How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!”
controles.kjv: How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!
controles.livre: Como caíram os valentes, E pereceram as armas de guerra!
